title: Font size of Error and Event List
body: ... is very large. Nightly of 15th of October.

comments.body: Which handset are you using? What are the screen dimensions?

I'm using an Atom with 432x230 pixels on a 2.45 inch screen.

It was unreadable before (too large).

IMHO text should always adjust to the density - and normally does if you use dp or sp as unit. Here with the bindings it is an absolute value.

@AdrianLxM Has this been addressed, or is it still the same?
Thanks
